len.name: Len
len.description: A singer from another Sekai. Uses his love of bananas to do a <c=keyword>little bit of everything</c>.

EnabledMikuAI.title: Enable Act I Elite: MIKU
EnabledMikuAI.description: Whether to add this enemy to the pool or not.

EnabledSounds.title: Enable Intrusive SFX
EnabledSounds.description: Various cards trigger SFX-based music which may be annoying for some.

EnabledBlood.title: Enable Intrusive SFX
EnabledBlood.description: Various cards trigger SFX-based music which may be annoying for some.

BananaTreat.name: Banana Treat
BananaTreat.description: At start of turn, <c=action>eat</c> <=boldPink>{0}</c> <c=status>bananas</c> without reducing the stash.

MusicNote.name: Music Note
MusicNote.description: At start of turn, add a special card to hand. Gain 1 <c=status>note</c> on turn end if <c=hurt>hull</c> at or below <c=redd>half</c>. Reset at <c=keyword>12</c>. <c=status>Persists across battles</c>.

BananaTree.name: Banana Tree
BananaTree.description: At start of turn, gain 2 <c=status>bananas</c> per tree.

Butterfly.name: Butterfly
Butterfly.description: Rock-based lifeform. When destroyed, the attacker gains 1 <c=status>NOTE</c>.

EatBanana.name: Eat Banana
EatBanana.description: <c=action>Eat</c> a <c=status>banana</c>, making the enemy so hungry they lose <c=hurt>{{Damage}}</c> <c=hurt>hull</c>.

ThrowBanana.name: Throw Banana
ThrowBanana.description: <c=action>Throw</c> a <c=status>banana</c> so fast it deals <c=boldPink>{{Damage}}</c> damage to the enemy.

ButterflyField.name: Butterfly Field
ButterflyField.description: Instantly turn every <c=midrow>object in the midrow</c> into <c=midrow>butterflies</c>.

m&k: This card has three separate sets of actions.
In combat, <c=keyword>right click or ctrl-click</c> this card to switch between them.
controller: This card has three separate sets of actions.
In combat, press {{Button}} on this card to switch between them.

BananaSnack.name: BANANA SNACK
BananaSnack.description: At start of combat, lose 1 <c=status>BANANA</c> to gain 1 <c=status>BANANA TREAT</c>.

GlassBottle.name: GLASS BOTTLE
GlassBottle.description: At start of combat, gain a <c=card>Wish in a Bottle</c>.

MaidDress.name: MAID DRESS
MaidDress.description: All <c=status>BANANAS</c> give you 2 <c=status>SHIELD</c> before <c=action>eating</c> or <c=action>throwing</c> them.

TwinPower.name: TWIN POWER
TwinPower.description: Gain 1 extra <c=energy>ENERGY</c> every turn. <c=downside>On even turns, enemy ship gains 2</c> <c=status>overdrive</c>.

ToluthinAntenna.name: Toluthin Antenna
ToluthinAntenna.description: Gain 1 <c=status>note</c>. Add 1 of {{Amount}} <c=cardtrait>discount, temp</c> cards to your hand.

LenExe.name: Len.EXE
LenExe.description: Gain 1 <c=status>banana tree</c>. Add 1 of {{Amount}} <c=cardtrait>disc, temp</c> <c=ffe569>Len</c> cards to your hand.

Encore.name: Encore
Encore.descriptionLen: Add 3x <c=cardtrait>disc, temp</c> <c=ffe569>Banana</c> & <c=ffe569>Fan Letter</c> & <c=ffe569>Close To Gray</c> to draw.
Encore.descriptionMiku: <c=hurt>Turn End:</c> Add 1 <c=7ed2d6>Fan Letter</c>, 1 <c=7ed2d6>Set Trend</c> & 2 <c=7ed2d6>World Is Mine</c> to draw.
